verdict.rationale: treg publishes its own API reference: 159 documented operations, an OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and catalogued endpoints that each list price, parameters and an example response. Agents can also explore the catalog programmatically through search and platform listings. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or a 'try it' runnable-example experience; example responses are static, not runnable. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer UI, runnable/try-it examples in the reference, hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response.
Search by what you want to _do_, not by vendor: `GET /catalog/search?q=backlinks`.
